title: Compose the design-read port into the production daemon listener
description:
SPIDR child of task-8a6d6660, spun from task-7ca9dca3 (architect-2e480458, 2026-09-05) because wiring the listener AND composing it into daemon-store-foundation-composition.ts + daemon-entry.ts + FACTORIES + providerKeys exceeds the 10-file cap.

OBJECTIVE: the production daemon (daemon-main / createStoreDependencies) actually supplies the design-read port the listener already knows how to call.

DELIVERABLE: factory in daemon-store-foundation-composition.ts, forwarded in daemon-store-dependencies.ts, listed in FACTORIES (daemon-entry-port-resolution.ts) and providerKeys, spread in daemon-entry.ts onto StartListenerOptions.

NOT IN SCOPE: the HTTP handler and JSON_ROUTES (task-7ca9dca3), UI, MCP.

VERIFICATION: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` plus `pnpm typecheck`.
definitionOfDone: createStoreDependencies / the foundation composition root exposes a designReads factory that closes over the project store and calls readDesignRevision. providerKeys and FACTORIES include the new key.

daemon-entry resolves the factory and passes it into StartListenerOptions. A production boot with the factory present answers POST /design/read from the real store (DESIGN_REVISION_ABSENT on a fresh project is a valid answer).
daemon-store-dependencies.test.ts providerKeys pin includes the new key. Deleting the factory from the shipped object reds that pin.
Gates quoted WITH `Test Files N passed`: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`.
taskRails: Do not edit design-read.ts or http-listener-read-dispatch.ts — those belong to task-7ca9dca3.
Wire an optional designReads factory the same way goalSource/documentDossiers are wired. A missing factory must keep the UNAVAILABLE refusal, never invent a design.

If the HTTP route is absent, STOP and report_blocked with blockedOnTaskIds [task-7ca9dca37fb44b40ac35abfc3c36cb9a]. Record the landed field name and DesignReadPort import path. (b) Confirm createDesignReadPort at mcp-design-read-query.ts:37 — reuse it; do not write a second factory. (c) Trace the goalSource chain end to end (composition factory, store-deps forwarder, FACTORIES, hasMethods ["read"], ports spread, daemon-entry spread, providerKeys). (d) `git status --porcelain -- apps/daemon/src/` — peer dirt is context. Put the landed option name and the current providerKeys list in the step note.

TESTS FIRST (skill test-driven-development). Do not implement production yet.

(1) daemon-store-dependencies.test.ts: insert "designReads" into the sorted providerKeys list (after "documentIngest", before "goalCatalog"). Add an arm like the document-dossier one at :271: provider.designReads?.() is defined; port.read({ goalRef: "goal-missing", projectId: PROJECT }) returns DESIGN_REVISION_ABSENT with layer LEDGER; aggregate version unchanged (no write).

(2) daemon-entry-ops.test.ts: add an arm modelled on :83-109. startDaemon with a real-enough authenticator holding GOAL, and designReads: () => createDesignReadPort({ store }) OR a stub { read: () => ({ ok: false, code: "DESIGN_REVISION_ABSENT", layer: "LEDGER" }) }. POST `/design/read` with body { goalRef: "goal-1" }. Expect the stub/store answer (code AND layer), not LISTENER_DESIGN_UNAVAILABLE. A 503 UNAVAILABLE here means daemon-entry did not forward the port.

Run `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` and quote the providerKeys / UNAVAILABLE reds.

WIRE THE FACTORY. daemon-store-foundation-composition.ts (515 lines — add only):

- add designReads to the frozen return object next to goalSource.

daemon-store-dependencies.ts: add a forwarder next to goalSource that throws if fromEnv() omits it (same "unreachable: ... always wired" shape). The shipped default object is what daemon-main loads; composition-only is invisible.

Do not reimplement readDesignRevision. Do not close over projectId — the HTTP handler passes principal.projectId.

RESOLVE AND FORWARD INTO THE LISTENER. daemon-entry-port-resolution.ts (441 lines — add only):

- FACTORIES: add "designReads" next to "goalSource".
- In resolveOptionalDaemonPorts, copy the goalSource block (factory function check, call, hasMethods(port, ["read"])).
- Spread into the ports object.

daemon-entry.ts: in the startControlRoomListener call, add `...(resolved.designReads === undefined ? {} : { designReads: resolved.designReads })` next to goalSource. If HTTP landed a different option name, use that name on both sides.

Re-run `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`. Step-2 reds go green. Quote Test Files N passed.

MUTATION DRILL, GATES, ADVERSARIAL (skill adversarial-self-review). git status --porcelain the exact paths first. All files here are tracked; empty git diff after restore is valid.

(a) Remove designReads from the composition return object only -> providerKeys or the "always wired" throw reds.
(b) Remove it from FACTORIES only -> startDaemon with the factory present still answers LISTENER_DESIGN_UNAVAILABLE (resolution never calls it) and the entry-ops arm reds.
(c) Remove the daemon-entry spread only -> same UNAVAILABLE. Restore each.

GATES standalone foreground: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` (complete_task verification command), `pnpm typecheck`. Quote Test Files N passed. Path-attributed baseline for foreign red.

Adversarial: missing factory still UNAVAILABLE (never invents a design); port.read does not take projectId from the caller payload; HTTP and MCP share createDesignReadPort; design-read.ts untouched. Report every path in complete_step.modifiedFiles.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: 1) Invent a second DesignReadPort factory in foundation-composition. Rejected: createDesignReadPort already exists at mcp-design-read-query.ts:37, closed over the store, read() taking DesignReadInput (projectId included). Reuse it so HTTP and MCP share one port type. 2) Land composition in the HTTP handler row. Rejected at the 10-file cap (that is why this row exists). 3) Close the port over projectId as well as store. Rejected: the MCP factory takes store only; the HTTP handler (task-7ca9dca3) is specified to pass principal.projectId into the read. Binding projectId twice would hide a principal/project mismatch. 4) Skip daemon-entry-ops POST proof. Rejected: DoD 2 requires a production boot to answer POST /design/read, which only startDaemon+listener proves.

planningNotes.risks: HTTP row may export its own DesignReadPort from design-read.ts that collides with mcp-design-read-query.ts. Prefer one type: import createDesignReadPort from mcp-design-read-query.js unless HTTP's landed StartListenerOptions type is incompatible — then a one-line adapter, never a second readDesignRevision. If DESIGN_READ_PATH is still absent at WORKING claim, report_blocked on task-7ca9dca3. providerKeys is exact-set: a missing or extra key reds.
